figurative_meaning_en: United or taking shelter together in one place
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা সবাই একঠাঁই থেকে সুখে জীবন যাপন করে।
দুই ভাই একঠাঁই মিলে ব্যবসা চালায়।
example_sentences_in_english: They all live together under one roof happily.
The two brothers run the business united in one place.
history: References Rabindranath Tagore's line 'দুটি প্রাণ এক ঠাঁই' from his literary works, symbolizing deep emotional union.
note: Often used in poetic or romantic contexts to denote inseparable bonds.
